an9.62:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] nava bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo arahattaṃ sacchikātuṃ
an9.62:1.3: rāgaṃ, dosaṃ, mohaṃ, kodhaṃ, upanāhaṃ, makkhaṃ, palāsaṃ, issaṃ, macchariyaṃ.
an9.62:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave nava dhamme appahāya abhabbo arahattaṃ sacchikātuṃ.

an9.62:2.3: rāgaṃ, dosaṃ, mohaṃ, kodhaṃ, upanāhaṃ, makkhaṃ, palāsaṃ, issaṃ macchariyaṃ.
an9.62:2.4: ime kho bhikkhave nava dhamme pahāya bhabbo arahattaṃ sacchikātunti.
